description:
Priority: P2 | Area: product | Labels: docs,P2 | Milestone: v0.1.0 | RFC: none | Task: CTX-0003

Record the owner-approved Wheel scope from research record 046 (research/summary/046.md, origin/046.md) in this repository: Wheel is the official Agent Harness plugin for the Bitty terminal scoped to software engineering only (Coding domain fixed; roles Primary/Commander/Coding/Review/Debug/Research vary inside it; staged MVP single Primary -> Primary+Subagents -> Commander). Personal/Office/always-on agents are separate future plugins, never Wheel scope.

Deliverables:
1. README.md: new Scope section with the Coding-only positioning plus the Non-goals list (not a personal assistant, not a general-purpose autonomous agent, not a messaging gateway, not an email/calendar assistant, not home automation, not a lifelong user-memory system, not a cron/automation daemon, not a general cloud-management agent). Cite research 046 as provenance; English-only.
2. AGENTS.md: extend the Plugin identity and scope section with the same scope statement (one or two bullets), plus a pointer that Personal/Office agents are separate repositories.
3. Evidence: just check exit 0 (lint/fmt-check/manifest/lua/lua-control), git diff --check clean.

Out of scope: any harness code, manifest/capability changes, staged MVP work, LLM-provider split (tracked separately in bitty-ai-docs from research 047). Stop at review; do NOT commit, push, or open PRs.
title: Record Wheel Coding-Agent scope and Non-goals (research 046)
